brief: Design the bottle + packaging for "Conceptial", a new luxury fragrance. Give ONE distinct, bold creative design direction — form, material, finish, palette, and the world it lives in. It must be an ownable, manufacturable object. Avoid cliches: clear rectangular glass, gold cap, serif-on-white, crystal stopper, atomizer + tassel, minimalist flacon. Respond as JSON: {"name": str, "form": str, "material_finish": str, "palette": str, "world": str, "image_prompt": "<one vivid art-directed render prompt>"}.
